data.open5gs-amf:
logger:
  file:
    path: /open5gs/install/var/log/open5gs/amf.log
global:
  max:
    ue: 1024
amf:
  sbi:
    server:
    - address: 0.0.0.0
      port: 7777
      advertise: amf-svc.share.svc.cluster.local
    client:
      nrf:
      - uri: http://nrf-svc.share.svc.cluster.local:7777
  ngap:
    server:
    - address: 0.0.0.0
  metrics:
    server:
    - address: 0.0.0.0
      port: 9090
  guami:
  - plmn_id:
      mcc: 460
      mnc: 99
    amf_id:
      region: 2
      set: 1
  tai:
  - plmn_id:
      mcc: 460
      mnc: 99
    tac: 1
  plmn_support:
  - plmn_id:
      mcc: 460
      mnc: 99
    s_nssai:
    - sst: 1
      sd: '000001'
    - sst: 2
      sd: '000001'
    - sst: 3
      sd: '000001'
  security:
    integrity_order:
    - NIA2
    - NIA1
    - NIA0
    ciphering_order:
    - NEA0
    - NEA1
    - NEA2
  network_name:
    full: Open5GS
  amf_name: open5gs-amf0
  time:
    t3512:
      value: 30
